_about: Questions for the CCNL path (CCNL_PATH_ENABLED, src/rag/ccnl_path.py): six sectors, the contract named or to be inferred, on pay, ferie, preavviso, prova, malattia and disciplinare. 'sector' is a regex on the chosen sector's folded name (lowercase, no accents or punctuation); 'version' is 'testo consolidato' (the base is the sector's Testo Consolidato, with every renewal up to the date among the amendments) or 'latest renewal' (the sector's latest signed CCNL / accordo di rinnovo up to the date is in the chosen set); 'clause' a regex on the clauses found (reference, title, text); 'framework' the articles the answer should cite; 'ambiguous' whether the text leaves the variant open (the answer must then state its assumption). Written 28 Oct 2026 from the audit's sector names; the commercio / turismo keys corrected the same day from scripts/diagnose_ccnl.py (v18): the CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi is filed as 'Commercio - Confcommercio'; a supermarket may apply Confcommercio, Confesercenti or Federdistribuzione (ambiguous); a waiter's contract is one of the three associations' 'Pubblici esercizi' (ambiguous); a Confcommercio hotel is 'Aziende alberghiere', filed again as '... minori' with the same documents (not ambiguous). Run with: python tests/eval_narrative.py --ccnl (see tests/eval_ccnl.py).
